entries.title: The 250-bar eligibility rule costs 259-265 sessions in every window and 6pp/yr on a cold 2013 start. That is a deliberate rule (no thin-history listings), but nobody has priced the knife edge: rerun the same three windows at MIN_BARS 60/120/250 and measure the annualised return and the eligible-set size at the first trade. If 120 buys most of the return back without letting one-month-old listings in, the 250 is a 6-month tax rather than a safety margin; if the early bars are trash at 60, the 250 is earning its keep.
entries.source: r1120 burnin face: gate binds exactly at the earliest possible decision
entries.runner_note: r1121: knife leg added to the E44 census code path (MIN_BARS 60/120/250, per-knife checkpoints, resumable).
entries.answer: Not a tax. Lowering the gate to 120 does NOT buy the return back: wide ann gap 120-vs-250 = -0.21 / -0.07 / -1.22 / +0.91 pp on 2013/2016/2018/2020 starts, while the eligible set grows only +5/+6/+6/+13 names. The ordering is not monotone either -- at 60 bars 2013 and 2018 get WORSE (6.78 vs 7.61, 4.80 vs 7.02) but 2020 gets much BETTER (4.66 vs 0.49). So the 250 is neither a pure safety margin nor a uniform tax: it is a window-dependent filter, and the only window where the cheap gate clearly wins is the newest one.

Cut the same warm curve into thirds per era and report each third's spread: does the newest era decay monotonically (a trend), invert (one reversal), or is the flip simply the boundary landing on one bad stretch?

schema.entries[].worker_class: O-20260928-2210 (T-113 s1): self-contained = in-repo data, clone-and-run on ANY machine; bm-hosted = data physically on the lane host (e.g. astock panel bm-b) -- workers honor data locality, no fake sharing; autofill._pick + Tools/pool_worker.py both read it
schema.lane_guard: lane_owner=null/ANY=任何合法机可吃; 指名=仅该机(R31/R65 判例)
schema.single_writer: 本文件只由轮(控制面)写; Tools/autofill.py 只读(运行态在 results/autofill_state.json + runner 自身 checkpoint)
schema.workers_plan: O-20260924-2130 s1.1: ready 批注册必带 workers_plan（多核计划，如 {"workers": 12, "priority": "BelowNormal"}）；无多核计划不入池 (autofill C8 read-side 强制门)
